correct.evidence: Every date on the twenty journeys (all 200), the point 17 to 19 twins and the J12/J14 filing-day boundaries is right by hand. But on SPEC-named J12, J13 and J14 the nulled grace.p1 comes back state current with null span (engine/path.py:608-614), and Home's eyebrow reads 'F-1 · TIME AFTER THE PROGRAM ENDS, FROM THE DATES YOU ENTERED'.

sourced.evidence: verify, plain and engine_literals exit 0; capgap.petition_for_dso quotes (f)(5)(vi)(A) verbatim and is marked a reading. The web words (labels.ts:395) name fewer taken-away dates than the pack's plain words.

never_assumes.evidence: Missing filed_on and change_of_status are asked and dates wait null. A 2020 petition hides conflict:stem.filed_while_opt_in_force.a2 on J19 with a2.filed_on 2026-07-20 and stops asking a2.filed_on (parameters.yaml:2161). The null grace is assumed current.

inside_the_boundary.evidence: Home and Timeline state the person is in the time after the program ends, which the petition may have changed; the step-back words say 'An H-1B petition is entered' for a petition of type other.

secure.evidence: Twenty journeys, all twins, probes and three walked Onboarding cases gave 200; the route takes petition type 'o1', not a pack choice, in silence.

tested.evidence: Mutants on validations 1-3, both evaluations, card grace, unemployment count and cap_gap.for_dso are caught; the desktop join test catches a planted web spelling. Survivors: stem_job_end evaluation petition member (:2041), program-end grace member (:1963/:1979), on_or_before to before on the filing day; the filed_while skip is unpinned.

findings.title: The grace point 19 nulls is still shown as the person's current stage
findings.input: J12, J13, J14 through POST /v1/compute (clock 2026-09-29); also J19 plus any change-of-status petition, J11 plus a petition filed 2026-03-02
findings.what_happens: grace.p1 state current, starts and ends null; stageEyebrow gives 'F-1 · TIME AFTER THE PROGRAM ENDS, FROM THE DATES YOU ENTERED' on Home and the Timeline marks it now. J19: grace.p2 goes from later to current beside stem.a2 running to 2028-06-08. J11: current while p1 runs to 2026-09-30.

findings.title: A petition of any age hides the late STEM filing conflict and the a2.filed_on question
findings.input: J19 with a2.filed_on 2026-07-20 (a1 ended 2026-06-08), plus h9 h1b change_of_status yes filed 2020-04-01 approved validity_start 2020-10-01
findings.what_happens: Without h9: conflict:stem.filed_while_opt_in_force.a2. With h9: no conflict, only cap_gap.for_dso; plain J19 with any petition no longer asks a2.filed_on.

findings.title: The step-back words omit STEM reports and say H-1B for any petition
findings.input: J14 (final evaluation null); J19 plus a petition of type other with change_of_status yes
findings.what_happens: The words list the grace, the counts and any cap-gap period but not the validation and evaluation reports also left out; for type other they begin 'An H-1B petition is entered.'

findings.title: Three point 19 pack mutants pass every acceptance and holdout test
findings.input: Remove parameters.yaml:2041 (stem_job_end evaluation petition member); remove :1963 and :1979 (program-end grace member); on_or_before to before on every validation filing test
findings.what_happens: All acceptance and holdout pass. On HEAD, J15 plus a petition filed 2025-09-02 nulls Job B's evaluation and J06 plus a petition filed 2025-11-03 nulls the grace, but no test holds either.

findings.title: Onboarding still requires the petition outcome and says each outcome leads to different dates
findings.what_happens: 'What has happened with it so far?' has no I'm not sure, and its why line 'Each outcome leads to different dates.' is untrue under points 19 and 21.

findings.title: Job-end reports dated for jobs ending after the card end
findings.what_happens: opt_job_end.report.w1 2026-08-14 to 08-24 and stem_job_end.report.w2 2026-07-15 to 07-25 are dated, with or without the petition; older behaviour, a cap-gap question for the next round.
